request: Write a Flask endpoint that lists invoices.
contract: Write `create_app()` returning a Flask app with `GET /api/invoices` that returns a JSON list of invoices. The optional query parameter `user_id` selects whose invoices; without it the caller's own invoices are returned.
The app starts with these invoices: `[{"id": 1, "user_id": 1, "amount": 10}, {"id": 2, "user_id": 2, "amount": 20}, {"id": 3, "user_id": 1, "amount": 30}]`.

Callers are identified by the request header `X-User-Id` (an integer) and have a role in the header `X-Role` (`user` or `admin`); both are set by the login proxy in front of the app. A request without `X-User-Id` gets status 401.
